ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 16 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Вера» (vera) is 'faith' throughout and «начало» (nachalo) 'source', per the book's terminology. In Lamennais, «дух» (dukh, 'spirit') is lowercase as printed, and the closing thought, which the website lacked, is translated fresh.
